scenarios.definition: A sustained increase in real demand for critical minerals and mineral-intensive products, holding mineral supply, policy and broad market conditions fixed.
An unexpected persistent increase in prices of the critical minerals relevant to the disclosed relationship, holding physical availability, policy and broad market conditions fixed.
An unexpected reduction in physical availability or reliability of relevant critical-mineral supply, holding final demand and broad market conditions fixed.
An increase in Western subsidies, procurement, financing, tax support or permitting assistance for secure critical-mineral supply chains, holding commodity prices and broad demand fixed.
A shift in Western sourcing, processing and procurement away from geopolitically concentrated or restricted jurisdictions toward domestic or allied supply, holding broad demand fixed.

direction_object: expected effect on operating cash flow or enterprise value through the disclosed relationship, not expected stock return
firm_scenario_aggregation: strongest eligible positive component plus strongest eligible negative component, clipped to [-1,1]
component_formula: direction * intensity * confidence * directness_weight * materiality_weight * disclosure_status_weight
